name: Fin-ModernBERT
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from answerdotai/ModernBERT-base (config.json max_position_embeddings 8192). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder, alternating local (128) and global attention (every 3rd layer)
notes: ADDED 2026-10-29. A finetune of answerdotai/ModernBERT-base on ~20M deduplicated financial records (clapAI/FinData-dedup), not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.150B parameters (identical tensor set), 22 layers, 768 hidden, 8192 context. Recorded as a contender because the card prints a ModernBERT-base column in the same table as this model on both tasks, with all three models fine-tuned under one stated recipe (AdamW, lr 5e-5, batch 16, 5 epochs, seed 0) before scoring; rows are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Card says further evaluations are 'ongoing', so two datasets is the whole published evidence. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2025-09-06.

benchmarks.name: CIKM (datht/fin-cikm) F1-score
benchmarks.config: Card '### Results' table '| Dataset | Metric | FinBERT (ProsusAI) | ModernBERT-base | Fin-ModernBERT |': row CIKM 54.89 vs ModernBERT-base 53.08 (FinBERT 42.77), same table. All three fine-tuned with an identical recipe (AdamW, lr 5e-5, batch 16, 5 epochs, seed 0) before scoring; self-reported, no variance across seeds.
